description: Rename a space, chat, roll, collection, brand, or a picture, clip or sound in a space's Files (kind media, with space_id). A doc renames with update_doc_info; an uploaded document keeps its name. Everyone who can open it sees the new name. A brand keeps its old names, so chats that use them still find it.

id.description: Its id from list_spaces, list_space or list_brands (collection_id for a collection, media_id for media).

space_id.description: Media only: the space whose Files hold it.

name: rename
title: Rename
